Cardamom Pear Loaf

Baked by Ines Halvorsen

A warmly spiced loaf with toasted pears and freshly ground cardamom.

Makes 10 slices

Preparation: 20 minutes

Bake time: 55 minutes

From bowl to table: one hour and a quarter

Ingredients

  • 225 g plain flour, sifted
  • 150 g light brown sugar
  • 2 tsp baking powder
  • 1½ tsp ground cardamom
  • 120 ml sunflower oil
  • 2 eggs, beaten
  • 3 ripe pears, peeled and diced

Method

Prepare the fruit

  1. Peel and dice the pears, catching every drop of juice.

  2. Toss the pear pieces with one tablespoon of flour.

Make the batter

  1. Whisk the eggs with the sugar and oil until pale.

  2. Fold in the flour, baking powder and cardamom.

  3. Stir through the pears and scrape the batter into the tin.

  4. Bake at 180 C for about 55 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
